test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Several pictures and videos have been circulating ______ social media featuring her.
solution:
The correct answer is **"on"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"****on" **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The correct phrase is “on social media” as the preposition "on" is typically used while discussing social media in English..
 
• Thus,*** option 4)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us see the other such notable use of "on".

 
• When anything is a part of the Internet, we say that it is **"on the Internet,"** not "in" or "at" the Internet.

 
 
• **Example:** I found this poetry **on **the Internet.
